ownerDecisions: 2026-08-21 General Manager is the highest BUSINESS role and is NOT security administration. The workbook's CRED on Users and Roles/Permissions is deliberately NOT mapped to admin.* capabilities. Owner/Admin retain privileged access administration.

inventoryLookupReader.why: Lookup is the precondition for every other parts/warehouse task; nobody in these roles works without it.

inventoryPutAwayOperator.why: Normal floor work for associates. Deliberately not composed into managers -- see bin-administration SoD.

inventoryBinAdministrator.why: Defines where stock may live. Separated from put-away so the person defining locations is not the person filling them.

inventoryCycleCountCounter.why: Assigned per employee. Composing it would make every associate a counter and erode who is accountable for a count.

inventoryCycleCountReconciler.why: DECISIONS #111: a counter may not approve their own material variance. Must never be composed alongside the counter role.

inventoryTransferOperator.why: Moves custody between locations. Assigned to the people who actually run transfers, not to every warehouse employee.

inventoryReturnsIntakeClerk.why: Returns intake is a specific station. DECISIONS #118 keeps intake separate from disposition, which does not exist yet.

inventoryCatalogAdministrator.why: Catalog manage/activate is administration of the part master, not operating on it. Separated from lookup.

inventoryCreateExecutor.why: Its own definition marks it temporary. Flagged for retirement review rather than composed anywhere.

workOrderPartsPlanner.why: Parts planning against a work order is a specific responsibility, not an automatic part of service management.

crmActivityContributor.why: Logging customer activity is ordinary sales/marketing work; the matrix grants these roles Contacts CR.
